This reads more like a live journal rant rather than a feature request. 

I do know that the shield settings actually work for what they list. However the safety options that make the most sense to set are not usable per trust rank.

I have told VRChat to hide poor and very poor, and set a limit on download size. This results in seeing fallbacks most of the time in public instances.

I am curious about point 5. Maybe your advocating against people being afk in public worlds? People do intentionally sleep in VRChat

@{62df7cd83e007e467295c4e1|full_name} it might sound like a rant but i didn't know where else to post this plus i write of the very start feature/advice.

Like i said no matter what shiled settings you set up or avatar culling it doesn't matter the impostor it matters a instance full of pepole that makes you lag extremely badly even if you are away from them for some reason it still makes thier avatar load up causing me a lot of lag.

For number 5 i know there is people intetionally sleeping in vr cuddling and such i don't want create drama or anything for them. 

i'm just saying to implement a sort of pop up notification or a small sound notification to cheek if their still online that is all. they don't have to follow my advice it was just a suggestion.

Plus the most important to follow is number 4 along what's written after

@{64abc34392b91dde53195503|full_name} for number 4 the age thing, it's been mentioned enough times on twitter, the unofficial reddit, this feature tracker and people's blogs. 

Awhile back VRChat implemented server side performance data, previously VRChat would download any avatar and open it up to find out what the performance rank is. 

I was in a public instance last night with 40 people and I believe that every time someone would change avatar VRChat would basically reload their fallback. Other than my friends I only saw one other avatar. Personally I think any complaint about lag should include computer specs. I have a i5 10400 and GTX 1080. For VRChat purposes I might actually upgrade the CPU
